name: Kurisu Nozomu
source:
A 22 year university student. He is in his third year at a prestigious Tokyo university and uses the name of his school to help facilitate his part time job as a tutor.
While he is average looking he is quite muscular, charming and has a silver tongue, he has succeeded in sleeping with many of his tutor students and their mothers.
His parents are local celebrities and if he were to obediently return home he could get a job easily, however he is absolutely against such an idea. Even so he has no mind to go job hunting and instead plans to use Tatsunobu who is well connected to help him instead.
